he-xiangjian.period: Midea Group filings 2014; retired from operations 2012
he-xiangjian.summary: He Xiangjian founded Midea, retired from its operations in 2012 and is its largest shareholder. A trade-monitoring record shows Midea Group reported about US$133 million in government subsidies for 2014, a company-level figure that is common for large Chinese listed firms. No reviewed source shows him holding political office or obtaining a personal preferential benefit. This is not exoneration.
